name: unsafe fn before_exec < F > (& mut self , f : F) -> & mut process :: Command where F : FnMut () -> io :: Result < () > + Send + Sync + 'static ,
rule: Panicking in the closure `f`, which runs in the child process after `fork` and just before `exec`, is safe only if all format arguments for the panic message can be safely formatted, even though `Command` calls `std::panic::always_abort` before invoking the closure.
api: trait CommandExt  : Sealed { unsafe fn before_exec < F > (& mut self , f : F) -> & mut process::Command where F : FnMut () -> io::Result < () > + Send + Sync + 'static , }
expression: The supplied DSL cannot express this requirement: it provides no predicates for closure panics, panic format arguments, or their safe formatting.
